arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Stephen Bright argued the lower court made errors. He said the state ignored prior Supreme Court lessons.
The state argued the defense failed to object. They said the defense missed the chance to challenge the removals.
Justice Alito asked if the defense claimed three strikes were racial. He sought clarification on the specific number of jurors.

Chief Justice Roberts asked why the defense did not object earlier. He noted the burden to object falls on the defense.
